adaptations: Incoming host invocation replaces command-line launch.
Host HTTP perform replaces original socket scheduling and HTTP framing.

GET, six methods and JSON Body retained. Crawler preserves the upstream report and two asynchronous get-next/complete/aggregate workers over up to 32 distinct controlled authority/path pairs. Host HTTP combines transport phases; complete exchange failures increment Read, while the separate socket phase counters are unmeasured.
TLS/Unix transport become host-owned; the base fixture measures HTTP payloads. Separate configured-host HTTPS fixtures verify CA trust, hostname rejection, and the documentation client's mutual TLS.
Stackful source compatibility remains blocked without Boost.Context.
